# Surrey Contracting Limited — Full Business Description

Surrey Contracting Limited is a groundworks, bulk earthworks and demolition contractor headquartered at Unit 3, Tannery House, Tannery Lane, Send, Woking, Surrey, GU23 7EF. The company has been delivering residential, commercial and developer-led external works projects for over 15 years, self-delivering every discipline with its own teams, plant and operators — no chains of subcontractors. Strapline: Groundworks, Earthworks & Demolition across Surrey & the Home Counties.

## Services

Surrey Contracting delivers three core construction disciplines:

### 1. Groundworks (https://surreycontracting.co.uk/groundworks)
Foundations (strip, trench fill, raft and piled caps), foul and surface-water drainage, soakaways, attenuation, utility trenching and service ducting, concrete slabs and oversite, substructure and build to DPC, retaining walls and gabion structures, site preparation, reduce dig and muck-away. Delivered for residential extensions and self-builds through to commercial developments.

### 2. Bulk Earthworks & Excavation (https://surreycontracting.co.uk/earthworks)
Cut and fill operations to levels and tolerances, large-scale bulk excavation, site strip and topsoil management, stockpiling, site levelling, land clearance and remediation, capping, attenuation basins, ponds and bunds, and bulk muck-away using the company's own and partner fleet. Plant includes tracked excavators from 1.5 to 35 tonnes, dozers, dumpers and rollers, all with experienced in-house operators.

### 3. Demolition (https://surreycontracting.co.uk/demolition)
Commercial and residential structural demolition, internal soft strip-out, site clearance and enabling works, on-site concrete crushing and recycling, site hoarding and security, licensed asbestos removal, and waste management and disposal.

## Coverage Area

Based at Send, near Woking, Surrey, the company operates across Surrey, London and the South East — including Cobham, Leatherhead, Guildford, Esher, Woking, Reigate, Dorking, Epsom, Weybridge, Kingston upon Thames, Redhill, Surbiton, the wider M25 ring and the A3 corridor.

## Accreditations & Compliance

- CHAS accredited contractor
- Constructionline Gold
- SSIP (Safety Schemes in Procurement) certified
- SafeContractor approved (Alcumus)
- SMAS Worksafe
- CITB registered; operatives hold CSCS, CPCS and CCDO qualifications; NPORS and IPAF
- £10m public liability insurance
- RAMS, toolbox talks and site supervision on every project; audit-grade paperwork and O&M handover packs

## How the Company Works

1. Free measured site visit within 5 working days of enquiry — levels, access, services and constraints captured.
2. Fixed-price itemised quote: materials, plant, prelims and programme.
3. Mobilise and deliver: RAMS issued, plant booked, weekly progress reports.
4. Sign-off and handover: snag-walk, O&M pack, 12-month defects window.

The company responds to all enquiries within one working day.
